Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Do I have to book before coming?
Appointments are recommended, especially for first-time visitors, but walk-ins may also be accepted depending on availability. Would you like to know how to make an appointment?
I'd like to make an appointment.
You can book through the online reservation form on our website. If you'd prefer to arrange it by phone, I can have a staff member call you back to help with that. Would you like a callback?
By phone, please.
Of course. I can pass your details to our staff so they can call you back. May I have your name, please?
It's Yamada.
Thank you. Could you please provide your family name as well?
Taro.
Got it. Your full name is Taro Yamada. May I have a phone number where our staff can reach you?
Excuse me, I'm not sure I caught all of that. Could you give me the phone number once more, please?
Thank you. Let me confirm. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Is that correct?
The last part is 5679.
Thank you for the correction. Your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven nine. Is that correct?
No, that's wrong.
I'm sorry. Could you please give me the whole phone number again?
Thank you. Let me confirm. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right.
